review.official:
The leader of the
Glasgow
Gang's fighters in
Victoria
. During
the war
, she fought courageously alongside
Vina Victoria
and the
Exemplars
. After the war, she returned to Norport to continue running the Slobberknocker boxing gym. As one of our main points of contact at
Rhodes Island
's Victoria office, she is often invited to participate in practical combat training (essentially serving as a sparring partner) and occasionally helps Vina Victoria deliver messages back to Rhodes Island.

files.description:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9%
No visible Originium crystals have been observed on the surface of Indra's body. Though her disease is currently under control, she needs to be closely monitored.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Indra was injured during operations in Victoria, and became infected after long-term exposure to high levels of Originium particulate concentration.
After the war, she repeatedly refused the specialized physical exams prepared by Medical. Instead, she directed her colleagues, who had come to volunteer as medics, to treat local citizens first. At least three colleagues have raised objections to her indifference towards her own health.
'Tons of Londiniers who need help more than I do. 'Sides, I have to book a checkup at some point, else Vina'll duff me up. Again.'
——Operator Indra's reply

Technique was not allowed her to survive for years on the street, but rather raw force and combat instincts. She developed into a great fighter through street brawling since childhood, and her confidence in her own two powerful fists enabled her to defeat countless foes.

Glasgow hung out in the slums of Victoria, getting their start as a street gang led by Morgan and Indra. They carved out their turf and survived in the anarchy, until Siege showed up and handed the supremely confident Indra her first ever defeat.

It wasn't just a simple defeat, since Siege's character and vision converted both Indra and Morgan into loyal friends and cohorts. Even though Siege never liked to pull rank, Indra still saw herself as Siege's most devoted follower and would do anything for her. Who knew a thug too lazy to be bothered with the concept of knighthood would exemplify the spirit far more than the official knights of Kazimierz?

The straightforward Indra hates sly, glib people who play games. Face to face, out in the open, that's what fighting is all about! Only cowards would act like a weasel! Her bold personality has made many like-minded colleagues her buddies at Rhodes Island. They would spar and discuss battles in the gym, then go for a big feast together after a sweaty workout and mock the supposedly 'brainy' Operators behind their backs. What else could be better than this in life?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If you got enemies about, just scream. I'll keep ya safe.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Where's that kid gone off to? Y'know, her... the really tanned shorty who's always trailing our Master... 'Morgan' is her nam- Oi! Stop right there!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours, we keep it real that way, yeah? You treat me with respect, I'll do the same for you.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Seems our Majesty's really into your place. Don't see that every day, seeing as we're never anywhere same for long.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Work or what have ya, you've gotta have guts!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, chew before you swallow, mate! HEY! SOMEONE BRING US MORE MEAT! This girl's got an empty belly to fill!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Bleeding Morgan... she might seem like a layabout mostly, but she's our tactician when push comes to shove. Gets the job done. Gets on my nerves otherwise, though, and she loves it. Tch...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doesn't she look brilliant, like a liege with a hammer in hand? I'm even more keen to see the look of her holding a sword, though.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Out with it! Don't beat around the bush, just say it: who do you want dealt with?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Tch. look at you spacing out like an idiot... Your own bloody fault if a tiger bites you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Indra. I don't have any of those weird crazy powers -- I let my fists do the talking. Nice to meet ya!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Niiice, this is good stuff.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotions are great, almost as great as fighting is!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Don't be afraid. I'll protect ya.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Where's the battlefield?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: So, who's in the market for a walloping?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Mind your own sodding business and let me be!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Come on! Show me what you've got!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Oi!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Get on with it, plod!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Haha!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: All right, it's my turn!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You bastard!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Nothing can stop me!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You're dead meat!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Give it up!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That's the stuff! That's what I call a kick!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You don't go home happy without some bloodshed!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Tch, we've got some who fled. Bunch of cowards.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Not bad... But I'll get you back for this!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What's this room about? More of a squeeze than anywhere I've been.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oi! You got a bleedin' death wish?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: C'mere, lemme get my arms around you! Yes, I mean hug you!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ooh! Gotcher end-of-year bonus? Haha, I must be due for one too, scrapping so much on your behalf! You and me, we're fellows now, no two ways about it! Get up, I'm taking you out for food!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What's up, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Hah, it's your birthday today, then. Here's a prezzie: these brass knuckles. They're the tiger's choice, get all your average muckers done and dusted! You should learn to watch yourself too, I say. Can't always count on me being there when you're in danger, right? Still, if I'm around and anyone picks on you, their arse is good as kicked!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Vina trusts Rhodes Island. That's why I take orders from you, no hesitation. But you listen here, Doctor. You need to feel the weight of that trust. Else I'll make you feel it, even if I need my fists to do it—and I don't mean wanting to scrap with you. But you just keep what I've said in mind.
